## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      3 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Jun 28, 2026 - Sep 1, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Sam Hyland_, Sep 1, 2026, 1/5: "Signed up for 3 months, app took 50e out of my revolut account but message on the app said payment failed. So now I still have no access and they just took 50e from me. Be very careful here and read trust pilot reviews first, something I should have done"
            2. _Isidro Erazo_, Jun 28, 2026, 1/5: "These people won't let you cancel the year subscription. looks like the company needs money"
            3. _Jack Leonard_, Aug 20, 2026, 2/5: "Not great for strength/hypertrophy. This app is so close to being amazing, all it needs is the ability to properly interact with the 'AI' to create proper workouts for muscle growth. Other reviews have pointed out the specific deficiencies for strength training. It is probably good if you want to lose weight (i.e. low weights, high reps, repeated for the same muscles day after day), and the UI is generally good too. It is overpriced but I get the subscription for free with my bank."
<!--/ir-theme-->
